//: durable rig config for the RippleTypeHero Framer port. Colocated with the target on purpose: the rig's server is regenerated per session, so anything held there had to be re-pointed every time. Carries RANGES and TOOLTIPS, never values -- the component's own defaultProps stay the single source of truth for current values, and the bench adopts them at boot.
sameHostNote: Open the bench at http://localhost:8792 so it frames http://localhost:3117 as SAME-SITE. Mixing localhost and 127.0.0.1 makes Chrome throttle the iframe's rAF and the water freezes at frame one while sync calls still work. See the note in framer/rig/rig-bench.html.
clockNote: This component is pointer- and simulation-driven, not clock-scrubbed. The bench's 0->1 playhead and content tracks do nothing here; the knobs are the whole value. Do not read a still playhead as a broken preview.

promotion.note: Apply writes the sidecar + snippet ONLY. Promoting a tune into the component's defaultProps and addPropertyControls defaultValue fields is a separate, explicitly-approved step -- for a Framer marketplace component the defaults ARE what a buyer first sees, so that promotion is the listing decision, not a tuning side effect.

knobs.label: relief
knobs.tip: Surface-normal exaggeration - also drives how hard the type warps.

knobs.label: glow
knobs.tip: Reflection / highlight gain on the crests.

knobs.label: caustics
knobs.tip: Chromatic focus under the crest. 0 is off.

knobs.label: ground
knobs.tip: The ground the water sits on. Reflection-only water only reads on a DARK paper.

knobs.label: headline
knobs.tip: Drawn into the scene and refracted by the water - not a DOM layer.

knobs.label: cta
knobs.tip: Toggles the ambient downpour. Empty hides the button.

templateGaps: The shared animation-rig bench template (templates/rig-bench.html) only renders numeric range knobs. Colour and text knob types were added in this run's copy at framer/rig/rig-bench.html and have NOT been promoted upstream to the skill.
